purpose: Visual references, not ground truth for arbitrary season/weather/hour combinations. Metadata and visible image content were both inspected. Dates are source metadata, not independently authenticated observations.
modifications: Resized JPEG previews only. Original composition, color processing, watermarks and credit strips are retained. No photographs are sampled by the shader.

items.title: Mount Fuji from Lake Kawaguchi
items.author: Subramaniam K V
items.captured: Capture date and local hour not established
items.observations: Broad snowy Fuji with an uneven summit, exposed dark channels, blue atmospheric foothills, shoreline buildings and broken sunlit lake ripples.
items.limitations: Snow is visible, but the source does not establish winter. Sun flare, exposure and this particular viewpoint are not reproduced. Daylight is visible; exact hour is unknown.

items.title: Mount Fuji from Lake Yamanaka 1995-7-30
items.author: Alpsdake
items.observations: Predominantly bare reddish-purple upper volcanic slopes with only tiny pale remnants, dark lower woodland, a developed shoreline and a darker rippled mountain reflection.
items.limitations: Lake Yamanaka is a different viewpoint, so its silhouette is not transferred literally. The red cast is illumination or photographic rendering, not a neutral rock-color measurement. This is one summer date, not a guarantee of snow-free summers.

items.title: Autumn leaf color and Mount Fuji from Lake Kawaguchi
items.author: Alpsdake
items.observations: A small irregular summit snow cap, hazy largely bare slopes, and red/orange foreground leaves mixed with dark evergreen shoreline vegetation under blue sky.
items.limitations: Near-camera red maple leaves do not imply that the entire mountain turns red. The shader uses patchy lower-elevation foliage, not this exact tree or composition. The metadata hour is morning, not proof of dawn.

items.title: Japan (16230424045) / autumn sunset at Kawaguchiko
items.author: Moyan Brenn
items.observations: Peach-colored cloud edges and lake highlights contrast with blue-violet mountain layers; the summit snow cap is small and shoreline buildings remain visible.
items.limitations: Sunset is supported by the source description, but the timestamp conflicts with a local sunset interpretation. Timezone is unverified. Color processing and softened water are not a radiometric or wave-motion measurement. The original credit strip is retained.

items.title: Sky, Cloud and Mt. Fuji (14933845455)
items.author: Yoshikazu TAKADA
items.observations: Mostly snow-free volcanic slopes, green lower ridges, a small summit cloud cap, large soft high cloud against blue sky, and fine ripples on a blue-green lake.
items.limitations: This shows broken cloud and considerable blue sky, not full overcast or fog. No cloud speed can be inferred from a still. The shader does not reconstruct its cloud cap, boats, park or lens composition.

items.title: Mount Fuji at night, Kawaguchiko
items.author: Sergiy Galyonkin
items.observations: A dark, nearly snow-free mountain silhouette behind town lights under a luminous blue evening/night sky; vehicle light trails are visible.
items.limitations: This is a town-facing elevated view, not a lakeside winter midnight scene. Light trails demonstrate exposure effects. It does not validate the shader's moon, stars, winter snow or unaided-eye night brightness.
